question: Rash Behari Bose was a key figure in forming the Indian Independence League and played a crucial role in the initial organization of which army?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Azad Hind Fauj**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Rash Behari Bose** was a prominent leader in the Indian independence movement and played a vital role in the formation of the **Indian Independence League (IIL)**, which aimed at organizing Indians living abroad for the liberation of India.
 
• He was instrumental in laying the groundwork for the **Azad Hind Fauj** (Indian National Army or INA), which was later led by **Subhas Chandra Bose**.
 
• The **Azad Hind Fauj** was initially formed in 1942 in Japanese-occupied Singapore, with the support of the Japanese Army, to fight against British colonial rule in India. Rash Behari Bose was a key figure in its initial organization.
 
• Rash Behari Bose handed over the leadership of the **Indian National Army** to **Subhas Chandra Bose** in 1943, who then restructured and revitalized the army to fight for India's freedom.
